blocks.text: LEGAZPI CITY, Albay — Four natural and historical sites in Albay province are being eyed for development as sustainable tourism destinations under bills sponsored by Rep. Raymond Adrian Salceda. The proposed measures seek to generate jobs, protect the environment and preserve local heritage while promoting tourism beyond the province’s main attraction, Mayon Volcano. Salceda sponsored House Bill Nos. 4002, 4008, 4010 and 4013, covering Mount Quiasog in Libon, Simeon Ola Cave in Guinobatan, Jovellar Cave and Underground River in Jovellar, and Buhawi Hills in Pio Duran.
